title: "I'll think about it" — real estate listing
summary: Warm sellers stall at the end of your listing presentation. Find out why.

brief.counterpart: Leila Haddad (speaking for herself and her husband), homeowners
brief.your_goal: Get the listing agreement signed or a firm decision date — or learn the real reason for hesitating
brief.setting: End of your listing presentation in the sellers' living room. Tea is on the table.

persona.name: Leila Haddad
persona.mood_at_start: Warm and hospitable; avoids saying no directly.
public_facts: Has lived in the house for 22 years
persona.budget_real: No price decision made; unsure whether to sell at all
persona.budget_stated: We'd want a good price, of course

variants.context: End of a listing presentation in the sellers' home. The user is the listing agent.
variants.user_objective: Get a listing agreement signed or a firm decision date, or learn the real reason for hesitating

hidden_facts.fact: They are also talking to another agent who promised a higher list price.

unlock.behavior: a label like 'It seems like something is holding you back'

black_swan.fact: They are not sure they want to sell: their son may move back home, and they haven't told the agent.

unlock.behavior: calibrated question about what is driving their timing

objections.text: We need to think about it.
objections.trigger: the agent asks them to sign

objections.text: Let us talk it over between us.
objections.trigger: the agent pushes a second time

success_criteria: Clear next step with a date
Correct choice: sign, or give them space for a family decision (no-deal is acceptable)
failure_conditions: Fake urgency such as 'prices are about to drop'
